title: Random-Probing Security of the Original Multiplication Gadget
summary: The original multiplication gadget of [4] is heuristically secure against horizontal attacks, but a formal random-probing security bound remains open.

formal_statement.body: Prove a formal random-probing security bound for the original multiplication gadget of [4].

scope.domain: Side-channel cryptanalysis of the original multiplication gadget of [4] in the random-probing model.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove a formal random-probing security bound for the original multiplication gadget.

citations.label: Masked Circuit Compiler in the Cardinal Random Probing Composability Framework

progress.summary: The source describes the original proposal as heuristically secure against horizontal attacks and presumed strong in the random-probing model, while emphasizing that it lacks a formal analysis in that model. The paper analyzes modified gadgets without settling the original construction.
citation_labels: Sonia Belaïd et al., Masked Circuit Compiler in the Cardinal Random Probing Composability Framework
